evidence_quotes.quote: should be having a direct apply button in the email itself, so that I don't need to waste time then navigating to the app

relations.rationale: 页面内嵌申请是'一切在门户内完成、不跳转别处'在公司门户申请这一具体情境下的具体化

evidence_quotes.quote: there is no point in having Linkedin. In the 1st place, when I have to like navigate to other place right.

relations.rationale: 门户内置收藏是'不跳转到另一个应用'在保存职位这一具体情境下的具体化

evidence_quotes.quote: It'd be great to have such features in the job portal itself, because I again, as I said, I don't want to navigate to another application

relations.rationale: T006 明确问通过哪些渠道接收职位更新，专业邮箱是接收匹配职位更新的选定渠道

evidence_quotes.quote: I would generally prefer getting via emails.

relations.rationale: 移动端通知是接收职位更新的另一渠道，且保留 unless 例外

evidence_quotes.quote: job notifications would also be great unless it's like too complicated.

relations.rationale: T041 明确用 'to kind of get me the relevant result' 表明关键词自定义服务于获得相关结果

evidence_quotes.quote: customizing few keywords for the job search to kind of get me the relevant result right?

relations.rationale: 资料驱动的自动筛选服务于提供已匹配的相关职位列表，无需再加筛选

evidence_quotes.quote: I kinda assume that it's already set right when it provides me the job list. and I don't need to add any more filters

relations.rationale: T032 问如何定义相关职位，T033 以技能匹配百分比工具作为判断相关性的方式，'So with that, I'll consider'

evidence_quotes.quote: I see if I can actually match those skill sets with me, and it can also give some percentage out of it. So with that, I'll consider.

relations.rationale: T085 用 'So' 连接：不希望被其他平台的人联系，因此不希望数据暴露给平台之外，前者以后者为实现方式

evidence_quotes.quote: I don't want to people reaching me out from other platforms, right? So I don't want my data to be exposed by other people apart from the platform.

relations.rationale: T004 问接收频率，主动求职时即时接收是接收匹配职位更新在该情境下的具体化

evidence_quotes.quote: so it would be great if I'm actually looking for Job right? So it would be great if I receive at the instant. The job is like posted in the platform

relations.rationale: 非主动求职时每周接收是接收匹配职位更新在另一情境下的具体化

evidence_quotes.quote: if I'm not looking actively, then it's okay to receive once in a week
